core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Fintech precision with Botanical organic feel.
Emotion First: Trust, Transparency, and Urgent Action.
Content is King: Data tells the story. Charts are the heroes.
Negative Space: Value 'dark white space' to reduce cognitive load.
Contrast: High contrast for readability in dark mode.
anti_patterns: No full-screen gradients - use subtle glows.

typography.installation: Import via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:opsz,wght@9..40,400;500;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Outfit:wght@400;500;700;900&display=swap');

usage_rules: Use 'background' (#0A0A0A) for the main app background.
Use 'card' (#121212) for dashboard widgets and containers.
Use 'primary' (#00E676) ONLY for primary actions (Submit, Verify) and positive data trends.
Use 'destructive' (#FF3D00) for high-risk alerts or negative trends.
Ensure all text on colored backgrounds meets APCA contrast standards.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-full px-6 py-2 font-medium transition-all shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,230,118,0.3)] hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(0,230,118,0.5)]
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/90 rounded-full px-6 py-2 font-medium transition-all
buttons.outline: border border-input bg-transparent hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground rounded-full px-6 py-2 transition-all
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground rounded-full px-4 py-2 transition-all

cards.base: bg-card text-card-foreground rounded-xl border border-white/5 shadow-sm p-6 hover:border-primary/20 transition-colors duration-300

inputs.base: flex h-10 w-full rounded-lg border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

navigation.sidebar: fixed left-0 top-0 h-full w-64 bg-card border-r border-border p-4 hidden md:flex flex-col z-50
navigation.mobile_nav: md:hidden fixed bottom-0 left-0 w-full bg-card border-t border-border p-4 flex justify-around z-50

hero_background.description: Abstract green light trails on black background - Use for Hero Section background or overlays.

card_accent.description: Green neon streaks - Use for 'Carbon Ledger' or 'High Tech' feature cards.

dashboard_context.description: African business team meeting - Use for 'About Us' or 'Team' context.

esg_report_cover.description: Group standing around table - Use for 'ESG Report' cover page or testimonial section.

setup: 1. Update tailwind.config.js with the provided color palette (extend theme).
2. Add the Google Fonts import to index.css.
3. Install framer-motion (npm install framer-motion) and lucide-react if not present.
4. Ensure 'shadcn-ui' components are installed or manually created in src/components/ui.
5. Use .js extensions for files as per project constraints.

implementation_strategy.dashboard: Build a 'Bento Grid' layout. Use the 'card' component for widgets. Ensure widgets stretch to fill height.
implementation_strategy.invoice_parser: Create a drag-and-drop zone with a dashed border (border-dashed border-2 border-muted-foreground/25). Use a loading animation during parsing.
implementation_strategy.carbon_ledger: Use a table component for transactions. Add a 'Verify' button with the 'primary' style.
implementation_strategy.greenwashing_detector: Use a text area for input. Display results with a radial progress chart (green = safe, red = risk).
implementation_strategy.navigation: Implement a sidebar for desktop and a bottom tab bar for mobile. Use lucide-react icons.

instructions_to_main_agent.file_structure_guidance: Since you are using .js, avoid TypeScript interfaces. Use PropTypes if validation is needed, or standard React props.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links). Format: 'page-section-element' (e.g., 'dashboard-stats-total-emissions').

universal_guidelines: Do NOT apply 'transition: all'. Use specific transitions.
Do NOT center align the main app container.
Dark mode is the DEFAULT and ONLY theme for this iteration.
